scope.profile: Existing shared GENERIC simulator resources with finite, non-null JSON values within the driver payload limit; integer values, including nested values, must fit the original signed Int64 protobuf encoding. scope.read: Native GetResource preserves exact False, zero, empty string/list/dict, nested dictionaries, float and Unicode values. Missing resources and invalid arguments fail with catchable SPELL exceptions.
scope.write: Native SetResource updates existing resources through real binary RPC and the persistent ground database. Dictionary values, including keys named like modifiers, remain data. Rejected names, arity, unavailable/non-finite/oversize values and unsupported local scope do not change resource state or create effect journal rows.
scope.existence: The SPELL proxy checks existence before the update RPC. The lower administrative RPC retains resource creation. This profile has no delete API; atomicity against external direct database deletion is not claimed.
scope.gdb: Actual original runtime GDB contains explicit fixture mappings and drives native resource calls. Examples113/140/141 exercise name/value and calibration lookups with independent persistent-state assertions.
scope.open: Example139 and DATABASE-GDB remain open because configured nonempty database-file loading is not demonstrated here. This report does not qualify broad COMMON modifiers, local resources, GetResources, resource-status/link APIs, or desktop behavior.
